overview: A three-tier leave management system comprising a React frontend (web-app) that provides the user interface for employees and managers, a backend leave-service (Go API) that handles all leave request logic, approvals, and balance calculations, and a PostgreSQL database for persistence. The frontend communicates with the backend via REST API, and the backend manages all business rules, user roles, and leave balances.
requirements: Employees must be able to submit leave requests by selecting start/end dates and leave type
Managers must view pending leave requests from their direct reports
Managers must approve or reject leave requests with audit trail
Employees must view status of their submitted leave requests (pending/approved/rejected)
All users must check remaining leave balance by leave type
System must enforce role-based access (employee vs manager permissions)
Leave requests must validate against available balance before submission
System must track leave types (annual, sick, personal, etc.)
System must maintain leave balances per employee per leave type
All API endpoints must include health checks for monitoring

components.componentAgentInstructions: Build a React 18+ single-page application using TypeScript and Vite as the build tool. Port 3000. Implement two main views: (1) Employee View with a form to submit leave requests (date pickers for start/end dates, dropdown for leave type selection), a table showing submitted requests with status badges, and a dashboard card displaying remaining balance per leave type. (2) Manager View with a table of pending requests from direct reports, approve/reject buttons per request, and filters by employee or date range. Use React Router for navigation between employee and manager views. Integrate with leave-service backend at environment variable REACT_APP_API_URL. Use fetch or axios for API calls. Implement error handling with toast notifications. Style with Tailwind CSS or Material-UI. Store user role (employee/manager) and ID in React Context after login simulation (hardcoded for MVP). Add loading spinners during API calls. Date picker should prevent past dates. Validate form inputs client-side before submission. Display leave types fetched from backend. Show success/error messages after actions. Implement a /health endpoint that returns {status: 'healthy'}. Dockerfile should use node:18-alpine, run npm install, npm run build, and serve static files with nginx on port 3000. Include nginx.conf to proxy /api calls to leave-service and serve React app on all other routes.

components.name: leave-service
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Leave Management Service API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Backend service for leave request management
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9090
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check endpoint
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: healthy
  /api/leave-types:
    get:
      summary: Get all leave types
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of leave types
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    id:
                      type: string
                    name:
                      type: string
                    maxDays:
                      type: integer
  /api/employees/{employeeId}/balance:
    get:
      summary: Get leave balance for an employee
      parameters:
        - name: employeeId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Leave balance by type
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    leaveTypeId:
                      type: string
                    leaveTypeName:
                      type: string
                    allocated:
                      type: integer
                    used:
                      type: integer
                    remaining:
                      type: integer
        '404':
          description: Employee not found
  /api/leave-requests:
    post:
      summary: Submit a new leave request
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - employeeId
                - leaveTypeId
                - startDate
                - endDate
              properties:
                employeeId:
                  type: string
                leaveTypeId:
                  type: string
                startDate:
                  type: string
                  format: date
                endDate:
                  type: string
                  format: date
                reason:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Leave request created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequest'
        '400':
          description: Invalid request or insufficient balance
        '500':
          description: Server error
    get:
      summary: Get leave requests (filtered by query params)
      parameters:
        - name: employeeId
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: managerId
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [pending, approved, rejected]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of leave requests
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequest'
  /api/leave-requests/{requestId}:
    get:
      summary: Get a specific leave request
      parameters:
        - name: requestId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Leave request details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequest'
        '404':
          description: Request not found
  /api/leave-requests/{requestId}/approve:
    post:
      summary: Approve a leave request
      parameters:
        - name: requestId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - managerId
              properties:
                managerId:
                  type: string
                comments:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Request approved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequest'
        '403':
          description: Manager not authorized
        '404':
          description: Request not found
        '400':
          description: Request already processed
  /api/leave-requests/{requestId}/reject:
    post:
      summary: Reject a leave request
      parameters:
        - name: requestId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - managerId
              properties:
                managerId:
                  type: string
                comments:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Request rejected
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequest'
        '403':
          description: Manager not authorized
        '404':
          description: Request not found
        '400':
          description: Request already processed
components:
  schemas:
    LeaveRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        employeeId:
          type: string
        employeeName:
          type: string
        leaveTypeId:
          type: string
        leaveTypeName:
          type: string
        startDate:
          type: string
          format: date
        endDate:
          type: string
          format: date
        numberOfDays:
          type: integer
        reason:
          type: string
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [pending, approved, rejected]
        managerId:
          type: string
        managerComments:
          type: string
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updatedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
components.componentAgentInstructions: Build a Go REST API service using net/http on port 9090. Use PostgreSQL as the database (connection string from env var DATABASE_URL). Implement the following database schema: (1) leave_types table with columns: id (UUID primary key), name (varchar), max_days (int). (2) employees table: id (UUID), name (varchar), manager_id (UUID nullable, foreign key to employees.id). (3) leave_balances table: id (UUID), employee_id (UUID, FK), leave_type_id (UUID, FK), allocated (int), used (int). Unique constraint on (employee_id, leave_type_id). (4) leave_requests table: id (UUID), employee_id (UUID, FK), leave_type_id (UUID, FK), start_date (date), end_date (date), number_of_days (int), reason (text), status (varchar: pending/approved/rejected), manager_id (UUID nullable, FK), manager_comments (text nullable), created_at (timestamp), updated_at (timestamp). Use lib/pq or pgx driver. Implement handlers for all OpenAPI endpoints. GET /health returns {"status": "healthy"}. GET /api/leave-types returns all leave types from DB. GET /api/employees/{employeeId}/balance joins leave_balances with leave_types to compute remaining = allocated - used. POST /api/leave-requests validates that start_date <= end_date, calculates number_of_days (business days between dates), checks employee has sufficient balance, inserts record with status=pending, and deducts used balance optimistically. GET /api/leave-requests supports query filters: if employeeId provided, return requests for that employee; if managerId provided, return pending requests where employee.manager_id = managerId; if status provided, filter by that status. GET /api/leave-requests/{requestId} returns single request with joins for employee name, leave type name. POST /api/leave-requests/{requestId}/approve checks that managerId matches the employee's manager_id, updates status to approved, sets manager_id and manager_comments, updates updated_at. POST /api/leave-requests/{requestId}/reject performs similar validation but sets status to rejected and restores the deducted balance. Handle edge cases: reject requests with status already approved/rejected, return 404 for missing records, return 403 for unauthorized manager actions. Seed database on startup with 3 leave types (Annual: 20 days, Sick: 10 days, Personal: 5 days), 5 employees (2 managers, 3 reports), and initial leave balances for all employees. Use UUIDs for all IDs (github.com/google/uuid). Enable CORS for frontend. Structure code with handlers/, models/, db/ packages. Include Dockerfile with golang:1.21-alpine base, multi-stage build, expose port 9090, and run binary. Implement graceful shutdown. Log all errors and requests to stdout.
